title: DreamStation Service Required Message
shortDescription: Machine has detected an internal fault that requires service.
fullDescription:
The Service Required message appears when DreamStation detects an internal hardware or self-test failure. Note the error code shown and contact your DME provider.

Given the 2021 Philips recall on many DreamStation units, check recall status on philips.com/src-update before continuing use.

fixSteps.title: Record error code
fixSteps.instruction: Note the numeric code shown below 'Service Required'.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 5 minutes and restart. If error returns, stop use.

fixSteps.title: Contact DME
fixSteps.instruction: Call your supplier. Do not open the machine.

whenToCallPro: Always - do not attempt internal repair on a medical device. Contact your DME, Philips, or healthcare provider.

faq.a: Check serial number at philips.com/src-update - many DreamStations were recalled in 2021 for foam degradation.

title: DreamStation Humidifier Disconnected
fullDescription: DreamStation's humidifier docks magnetically to the main unit. If the humidifier is disconnected or the contact pins are dirty, the machine reports the error. Clean and reseat to resolve.

fixSteps.title: Reseat humidifier
fixSteps.instruction: Separate and recouple the humidifier firmly.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe metal contacts with dry microfiber.

whenToCallPro: If reseating does not clear and humidifier is clearly attached, call DME.

faq.a: Yes - tap water causes mineral buildup and can trip the humidifier error.

title: DreamStation High Mask Leak
shortDescription: Machine reports mask leak above threshold.
fullDescription: DreamStation tracks unintentional leak and warns when it exceeds the threshold for too long. Replace worn cushions, re-fit the mask, and consider a chin strap if mouth leak is involved.

fixSteps.title: Replace cushion
fixSteps.instruction: Install fresh cushion appropriate for your mask.

fixSteps.title: Refit headgear
fixSteps.instruction: Tighten straps evenly - not overly tight.

whenToCallPro: Consult DME or sleep tech if leak persists after fresh cushion and refit.

faq.a: Full-face masks help mouth breathers. Ask your clinician about switching.

title: DreamStation System Fault
fullDescription: System Fault is a catch-all message for an unrecoverable internal error. Record the error number, cycle power, and if the fault returns contact your DME. Do not open the unit.

fixSteps.title: Contact DME
fixSteps.instruction: If fault repeats, request replacement or repair.

whenToCallPro: Always - contact DME and healthcare provider.

faq.a: No - do not use a CPAP with a persistent system fault.

title: DreamStation Check Tubing
shortDescription: Machine cannot recognize tube type or tube disconnected.
fullDescription: Check Tubing appears when the tube is not attached, is blocked, or the heated tube sensor is damaged. Confirm tube type in settings matches the tube attached.

fixSteps.title: Verify connection
fixSteps.instruction: Push tube firmly onto the outlet.

fixSteps.title: Match tube setting
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Tubing - confirm 12mm, 15mm, or heated to match the tube.

whenToCallPro: Call DME if new tube does not clear the error.

faq.a: Philips 15mm and 22mm tubes differ - match your machine's outlet.

title: Philips DreamStation Recall - Foam Degradation
shortDescription: DreamStation affected by 2021 foam degradation recall.
fullDescription:
In 2021, Philips issued a Class I recall for many DreamStation CPAP and BiPAP devices due to PE-PUR foam that could degrade and release particulates or chemicals into the airpath. Check your serial number on philips.com/src-update.

If recalled, register for remediation and discuss a replacement device with your sleep physician.

fixSteps.title: Check recall status
fixSteps.instruction: Go to philips.com/src-update and enter your serial number.

fixSteps.title: Register for remediation
fixSteps.instruction: If affected, register for a replacement device.

fixSteps.title: Consult physician
fixSteps.instruction: Discuss with your sleep physician whether to continue or pause therapy.

whenToCallPro: Always consult your healthcare provider. Do NOT attempt to open or modify the device. Follow Philips and FDA guidance.

faq.a: Do not stop without consulting your physician. The FDA advises a benefit-vs-risk discussion with your doctor.

title: DreamStation SD Card Not Recognized
shortDescription: DreamStation cannot mount the SD card.
fullDescription: DreamStation records therapy data to an SD card. When unrecognized, the card may be missing, corrupted, or physically damaged. Therapy continues but data is not written.

fixSteps.title: Reformat via PC
fixSteps.instruction: Back up first, then format card as FAT32 on a computer.

fixSteps.title: Replace card
fixSteps.instruction: Use a 2-32 GB SD card or one from DME.

whenToCallPro: Call DME if reformatted card still errors.

faq.a: No, therapy continues, only logging stops.

title: DreamStation Clock Error
shortDescription: Internal clock battery dead or time lost.
fullDescription: DreamStation uses an internal clock to timestamp therapy data. After long periods unplugged or when the internal battery weakens, the clock may reset. Set the time via Provider menu or have DME reset it.

fixSteps.title: Set time
fixSteps.instruction: Ask DME to set the correct time via provider menu.

whenToCallPro: DME typically sets the clock via provider menu.

title: DreamStation Data Error
shortDescription: Therapy data corrupted or could not be saved.
fullDescription: Data errors are usually SD card related. Reformat the card or replace it. Therapy continues to run normally.
whenToCallPro: DME if new card still errors.

faq.a: Local data yes, cloud data in DreamMapper is preserved.

title: DreamStation Pressure Malfunction
fullDescription: Pressure malfunction indicates the blower or internal pressure sensor is not performing within spec. This is a hardware fault - stop use and contact DME.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Install a fresh pollen filter at inlet.

whenToCallPro: Always after filter swap - do not run a CPAP with pressure malfunction.

faq.a: Untreated apnea is the real risk - work with DME for a loaner while repairing.

title: DreamStation Power Supply Issue
shortDescription: Machine detects incorrect or insufficient power.
fullDescription: DreamStation uses an 80W power supply. Using a non-Philips adapter or a damaged brick triggers a power supply error. Always use the Philips-supplied adapter.

fixSteps.title: Verify adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm you are using the Philips 80W adapter.

fixSteps.title: Replace adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Order a replacement Philips adapter from DME.

faq.a: No - use only the Philips adapter.

title: DreamStation Heater Disconnected
shortDescription: Heated humidifier plate cannot be detected.
fullDescription: The heater plate is part of the humidifier dock. When the machine cannot detect it, the heater is either disconnected or the contacts are dirty.
whenToCallPro: Call DME if cleaning and redocking does not clear the error.

faq.a: Yes - therapy continues without humidification, but may cause dryness.
